statement.p: Which is traveling faster, a car whose velocity vector is 29\vec i + 34\vec j, or a car whose velocity vector is 40\vec i, assuming that the units are the same for both directions?

?
the first car
the second car is the faster car.
At what speed is the faster car traveling?

static.solution: || 29\vec i + 34\vec j || = \sqrt{29^2 + 34^2} = \sqrt{1997} \approx 44.688 and || 40\vec i || = \sqrt{40^2} = 40. So the first car is faster.
